purpose: Provide the authenticated runtime CRM shell with permission-derived navigation, quick route switching, user context and a truthful assistant contract boundary.

accessibility.keyboard: Every navigation item and launcher remains reachable; quick navigation supports ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter and Escape.
accessibility.focus: The route owner focuses the new page heading after navigation.

invariants: navigationForSession supplies only routes authorized by businessRole and effective permissions; the shell never expands access.
Operational read routes may be shown to SUPER_ADMIN and SPECIALIST only with their explicit permission; admin routes remain SUPER_ADMIN-only.
The shell labels route lookup as Быстрый переход and never claims a global data search without an API contract.
The AI launcher exposes the missing backend contract and cannot produce a local answer or mutation.
Authentication screens never render this shell.
